addedLines: - claude: Catch-all for any task that doesn't fit a more specific agent. FleetView's default when no agent name is typed. (Tools: *)

- claude-code-guide: Use this agent when the user asks questions ("Can Claude...", "Does Claude...", "How do I...") about: (1) Claude Code (the CLI tool) - features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations, keyboard shortcuts; (2) Claude Agent SDK - building custom agents; (3) Claude API (formerly Anthropic API) - Messages API for directly passing messages to Claude, Tool Runner (`client.beta.messages.tool_runner`) for running an agentic loop over your own tools, manual tool-use loops, Managed Agents for server-hosted agents with a managed sandbox, prompt caching, and general Anthropic SDK usage; (4) Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) - what it is, setting it up for a Slack workspace, `/install-slack-app`; (5) `claude plugin eval` (writing and running plugin eval suites, its JSON/report, sandbox, CI, early-access enablement) and the `/skill-doctor` report. **IMPORTANT:** Before spawning a new agent, check if there is already a running or recently completed claude-code-guide agent that you can continue via SendMessage. (Tools: Bash, Read, WebFetch, WebSearch)

- Explore: Read-only search agent for broad fan-out searches — when answering means sweeping many files, directories, or naming conventions and you only need the conclusion, not the file dumps. It reads excerpts rather than whole files, so it locates code; it doesn't review or audit it. Specify search breadth: "medium" for moderate exploration, "very thorough" for multiple locations and naming conventions. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)

- general-purpose: General-purpose agent for researching complex questions, searching for code, and executing multi-step tasks. When you are searching for a keyword or file and are not confident that you will find the right match in the first few tries use this agent to perform the search for you. (Tools: *)

- Plan: Software architect agent for designing implementation plans. Use this when you need to plan the implementation strategy for a task. Returns step-by-step plans, identifies critical files, and considers architectural trade-offs. (Tools: All tools except Agent, Artifact, ArtifactComments, ArtifactData, ArtifactCheck, ExitPlanMode, Edit, Write, NotebookEdit)
- statusline-setup: Use this agent to configure the user's Claude Code status line setting. (Tools: Read, Edit)

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. When the destination is a first-party document connector (host-designated, never self-described) that renders live charts, hand it the rows (inline, or as an uploaded data file the chart cites) rather than a rendered PNG/SVG — a picture of a chart loses hover, data inspection and per-value comments. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. Triggers on: "chart", "graph", "plot", "data viz", "visualization", "dashboard", "analytics", "visualize data", "categorical colors", "sequential / diverging palette", "stat tile", "sparkline", "heatmap", "legend", "axis", "tooltip", "chart colors", "color by series".
- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.
- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: "rebind ctrl+s", "add a chord shortcut", "change the submit key", "customize keybindings".
- code-review: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level (low/medium: fewer, high-confidence findings; high→max: broader coverage, may include uncertain findings); with no level given, it reuses the level you typed last. Pass --comment to post findings as inline PR comments, or --fix to apply the findings to the working tree after the review.
- simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.
- claude-api: Reference for the Claude API / Anthropic SDK — model ids, pricing, params, streaming, tool use, MCP, agents, caching, token counting, model migration.
TRIGGER — read BEFORE opening the target file; don't skip because it "looks like a one-liner" — whenever: the prompt names Claude/Anthropic in any form (Claude, Anthropic, Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, `anthropic`, `@anthropic-ai`, `claude-*`, `us.anthropic.*`, `[1m]`); the user asks about an LLM (pricing/model choice/limits/caching) — never answer from memory; OR the task is LLM-shaped with provider unstated (agent/MCP/tool-definition/multi-agent/RAG/LLM-judge/computer-use; generate/summarize/extract/classify/rewrite/converse over NL; debugging refusals/cutoffs/streaming/tool-calls/tokens).
SKIP only when another provider is being worked on (overrides all triggers): OpenAI/GPT/Gemini/Llama/Mistral/Cohere/Ollama named in the query; OR `grep -rE 'openai|langchain_openai|google.generativeai|genai|mistralai|cohere|ollama'` over the project hits (run this grep FIRST if no provider named — don't Read the file).
- workflow-authoring: Reference for writing a Workflow tool script (script API and gotchas, resume, quality patterns, worked examples). Load before authoring a script for a workflow the user already opted into; it does not itself authorize running one.
- run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working. Use when asked to run, start, or screenshot the app, or to confirm a change works in the real app (not just tests). 判据

命令返回 `0`，并且生成：

```
<工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/CMakeCache.txt
```

---

## 4. 编译

```bash
cmake --build <工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai
```

### 判据

命令返回 `0`，并且生成：

```
<工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/nuttx.bin
```

**生成了就算成功。**

### ⚠️ 不要用 `bl_build.sh`

那个脚本假设构建目录**已经存在**，只做 `cmake --build`。第一次没有构建目录，用它直接失败。
它是原作者日常增量编译用的。

---

## 5. 改了代码之后

改完代码，**不用重新 configure**，直接重跑第 4 步的 `cmake --build`。

**唯一例外**：如果改的是 `defconfig`，**必须重跑第 3 步 configure**。

原因：`config.h` 是 configure 阶段生成的。只改 `defconfig` 再 build **不生效**。

**判据**（改完 defconfig 后）：

```bash
grep <你改的CONFIG项> <工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/include/nuttx/config.h
```

**看到新值才算生效**，然后再编译。

### 想改哪块代码，去哪

| 想改什么 | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| 界面 / 触摸 UI | `app/robot_ui/` |
| 语音对话主循环 | `app/hello_app/` |
| 板级驱动（音频、屏、USB） | `board/contest_board/src/` |
| 板级配置（开哪些功能） | `board/contest_board/configs/sf32lb52_ai/defconfig` |

（路径相对 `<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/`）

---

## 6. 烧录（以后改了代码才需要）

### 6.1 本板必须烧两个文件

| 文件 | 烧到 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/flash/ftab.bin` | `0x12000000` | 分区表，**启动必需** |
| `nuttx.bin` | `0x12010000` | openvela 镜像 |

**只烧 `nuttx.bin` → 板子完全静默**（SFBL 找不到镜像）。这是最常见的坑。

### 6.2 命令

```bash
sftool -p <串口设备> -c SF32LB52 -m nor \
    --before default_reset --after soft_reset --compat true \
    write_flash "<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/flash/ftab.bin@0x12000000" \
                "<工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/nuttx.bin@0x12010000"
```

- ⚠️ **`--compat true` 必须加。** 不加会报 `invalid response code: 0x40`
  （下载 stub 握手失败），看起来像"连不上芯片"。
- ⚠️ **`sftool` 必须是 0.2.5。** 下载：<https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/releases>
  版本不对的症状是一直 `Failed to connect to the chip`。
- **烧录时不要改 `-b` 参数。**
- 仓库里有现成脚本：`flash/flash_openvela.sh <nuttx.bin> <串口设备>`

### 6.3 判据

**退出码 `0`**，并且输出里有从 `0%` 到 `100%` 的进度行（每个文件一组）。

**退出码是 0 就算成功。** 不同版本 `sftool` 的输出文字不一样，别去比对某句固定的话。

### 6.4 烧完必须做的事

**物理拔插一次 USB。** 板子复位不会让主机重新枚举设备。

不拔插的话会出现「网卡显示 Up 但 ping 不通」的假象。

---

## 7. 串口

**波特率 1 000 000 8N1。不是 115200。**

用 115200 打开会看到乱码，**极像"板子死了"，其实只是波特率不对。**

### 板子的两根线是分开的

| 线 | 给什么 |
|---|---|
| **串口线**（CH343） | 能看到 NuttX 日志 |
| **原生 USB** | 才会出现那张 RNDIS 网卡 |

**别把这两件事混起来** —— 串口通了不代表网卡会出现。

### 串口工具会占住设备

如果串口工具开着，`sftool` 烧不了（报错看起来像"进不去下载模式"）。
**烧之前先断开串口工具。**

### Linux 下的串口工具注意

## 1. 拉代码

### 1.1 装两个工具

```bash
# git-lfs —— 大文件存储。**不装会拉不全**，这个项目用 LFS 存大文件
sudo apt install git-lfs
git lfs install
git lfs --version          # 有版本号输出就行
```

`repo` 工具如果还没有，见 [1.5](#15-拉不下来怎么办)。

### 1.2 配 SSH 公钥（用 SSH 协议才需要）

- Gitee：把公钥加到 <https://gitee.com/profile/sshkeys>
- GitHub：把公钥加到 <https://github.com/settings/keys>

**没配公钥会报「无法读取远程仓库」。**

### 1.3 初始化并拉取

**优先用 Gitee**（国内快、稳）：

```bash
mkdir <工作区>
cd <工作区>

repo init --partial-clone \
          -u https://gitee.com/open-vela/manifests.git \
          -b dev-ai-contest-2026 \
          -m openvela.xml \
          --git-lfs

repo sync -c -j4
```

参数说明：

| 参数 | 意思 |
|---|---|
| `--partial-clone` | 按需拉取，省时间也省断线概率 |
| `-b dev-ai-contest-2026` | **比赛分支，必须用这个** |
| `-m openvela.xml` | 用这份 manifest |
| `--git-lfs` | 启用大文件支持 |
| `-c`（sync 时） | 只拉当前分支 |
| `-j4`（sync 时） | 并发 4 个仓库 |

**GitHub 备用**（把 `-u` 换成 `https://github.com/open-vela/manifests.git`，其余相同）。

### 1.4 拉断了就重跑，不用从头来

**`repo sync` 支持增量。** 中断了直接再跑一遍同一条命令，它会跳过已经拉好的。

```bash
repo sync -c -j4          # 反复跑，直到完整
```

**这是常态，不是失败。** 249 个仓库要从网上拉，断一两次很正常。

### 1.5 拉不下来怎么办

**四个最常见的原因，对着现象查：**

#### ① 内存不足被杀 —— 最容易被误判成网络问题

**现象**：拉到一半，进程突然没了；`/var/log/syslog` 里有 OOM 相关日志。

**原因**：Ubuntu 22.04 之后，内存使用率超过 50% 并持续 20 秒、且回收不了时，
`systemd-oomd` 会直接杀掉进程。**物理内存低于 16 GB 的机器很容易中招。**

```bash
# 拉之前先关掉它
sudo systemctl stop systemd-oomd systemd-oomd.socket

# 拉完之后再开回来
sudo systemctl start systemd-oomd systemd-oomd.socket
```

#### ② repo 工具本身下载不了

**现象**：`Failed to connect to gerrit.googlesource.com`

**原因**：`repo` 这个工具自己要从 Google 的源下载（在墙外）。**这跟你的源码仓库地址无关。**

```bash
# 换清华源（推荐）
repo init ... --repo-url=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/git/git-repo

# 清华源不稳定时，换中科大
repo init ... --repo-url=https://mirrors.ustc.edu.cn/aosp/git-repo
```

（`...` 是 1.3 里那条命令的其余部分，照抄即可。）

#### ③ 传输中断

**现象**：`fatal: early EOF`

**原因**：SSH 协议在网络波动时稳定性不足，大文件传输容易超时。

**解法**：改用 HTTPS —— **1.3 里给的命令就是 HTTPS，所以正常情况下不会遇到。**
如果你是照别的文档用 SSH 配的，换回 1.3 那条。

#### ④ 并发太高

**现象**：一堆 `channel N: open failed: administratively prohibited` 警告，同步明显变慢。

**原因**：远程服务器限制了单条 SSH 连接的并发通道数。

**解法**：降并发重试。**这是非致命警告**，repo 会自动重试，但会很慢。

```bash
repo sync -c -j2
```

> 网络好的时候 `-j8` 更快，**只在出现上面这个警告时才调低。**

#### ⑤ 实在不行：删掉重来

如果 `.repo` 目录卡在不完整的中间状态：

```bash
rm -rf .repo
# 然后重新跑 1.3 的 repo init
```

**这是最后手段**，先试重跑 `repo sync`。

### 1.6 判据

```bash
ls <工作区>
# 期望：openvela   .repo

ls <工作区>/.repo/projects | wc -l
# 期望：249 左右
```

**`openvela/` 和 `.repo/` 都在，就算拉完了。** 缺哪个都停下报告。

## 2. 设环境变量

```bash
export PATH=<工作区>/openvela/prebuilts/tools/python/bin:<工作区>/openvela/prebuilts/tools/linux/x86_64:$PATH
export PYTHONPATH=<工作区>/openvela/prebuilts/tools/python/dist-packages/kconfiglib
```

### ⚠️ 这两条不设，后面一定挂 —— 而且报错指向的原因都是错的

| 现象 | 真原因 |
|---|---|
| `genromfs: command not found` | `PATH` 没设 |
| `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'olddefconfig'` | **`PYTHONPATH` 没设**，不是 Python 坏了 |

**看到 `olddefconfig` 找不到，不要去折腾 Python 环境** —— 回头把 `PYTHONPATH` 设上就行。

### 判据

```bash
which genromfs
python3 -c "import kconfiglib; print('kconfiglib OK')"
```

**两个都要有输出。**

⚠️ `export` 只在当前 shell 有效。**换个终端窗口就得重设一遍。**

```bash
cmake -S <工作区>/openvela/nuttx \
      -B <工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai \
      -GNinja \
      -DBOARD_CONFIG=../vendor/openvela/boards/contest2026_233_board/configs/sf32lb52_ai \

- `-DBOARD_CONFIG` 的相对路径是**相对 `<工作区>/openvela/nuttx` 解析的**，

- 这一步会生成 `nuttx/drivers/platform` 那条软链 —— **正常现象**，是 configure 阶段的产物。### 判据

命令返回 `0`，并且生成：

```

```

## 4. 编译

```bash
cmake --build <工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai
```

### 判据

命令返回 `0`，并且生成：

```
<工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/nuttx.bin
```

**生成了就算成功。**

### ⚠️ 不要用 `bl_build.sh`

那个脚本假设构建目录**已经存在**，只做 `cmake --build`。第一次没有构建目录，用它直接失败。
它是原作者日常增量编译用的。

## 5. 改了代码之后

改完代码，**不用重新 configure**，直接重跑第 4 步的 `cmake --build`。

**唯一例外**：如果改的是 `defconfig`，**必须重跑第 3 步 configure**。

原因：`config.h` 是 configure 阶段生成的。只改 `defconfig` 再 build **不生效**。

**判据**（改完 defconfig 后）：

```bash
grep <你改的CONFIG项> <工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/include/nuttx/config.h
```

**看到新值才算生效**，然后再编译。

### 想改哪块代码，去哪

| 想改什么 | 去哪 |
|---|---|
| 界面 / 触摸 UI | `app/robot_ui/` |
| 语音对话主循环 | `app/hello_app/` |
| 板级驱动（音频、屏、USB） | `board/contest_board/src/` |
| 板级配置（开哪些功能） | `board/contest_board/configs/sf32lb52_ai/defconfig` |

（路径相对 `<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/`）

## 6. 烧录（以后改了代码才需要）

### 6.1 本板必须烧两个文件

| 文件 | 烧到 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/flash/ftab.bin` | `0x12000000` | 分区表，**启动必需** |
| `nuttx.bin` | `0x12010000` | openvela 镜像 |

**只烧 `nuttx.bin` → 板子完全静默**（SFBL 找不到镜像）。这是最常见的坑。

### 6.2 命令

```bash
sftool -p <串口设备> -c SF32LB52 -m nor \
    --before default_reset --after soft_reset --compat true \
    write_flash "<工作区>/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/flash/ftab.bin@0x12000000" \
                "<工作区>/openvela/cmake_out/contest2026_233_board_sf32lb52_ai/nuttx.bin@0x12010000"
```

- ⚠️ **`--compat true` 必须加。** 不加会报 `invalid response code: 0x40`
  （下载 stub 握手失败），看起来像"连不上芯片"。
- ⚠️ **`sftool` 必须是 0.2.5。** 下载：<https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/releases>
  版本不对的症状是一直 `Failed to connect to the chip`。
- **烧录时不要改 `-b` 参数。**
- 仓库里有现成脚本：`flash/flash_openvela.sh <nuttx.bin> <串口设备>`

### 6.3 判据

**退出码 `0`**，并且输出里有从 `0%` 到 `100%` 的进度行（每个文件一组）。

**退出码是 0 就算成功。** 不同版本 `sftool` 的输出文字不一样，别去比对某句固定的话。

### 6.4 烧完必须做的事

**物理拔插一次 USB。** 板子复位不会让主机重新枚举设备。

不拔插的话会出现「网卡显示 Up 但 ping 不通」的假象。

## 7. 串口

**波特率 1 000 000 8N1。不是 115200。**

用 115200 打开会看到乱码，**极像"板子死了"，其实只是波特率不对。**

### 板子的两根线是分开的

| 线 | 给什么 |
|---|---|
| **串口线**（CH343） | 能看到 NuttX 日志 |
| **原生 USB** | 才会出现那张 RNDIS 网卡 |

**别把这两件事混起来** —— 串口通了不代表网卡会出现。

### 串口工具会占住设备

如果串口工具开着，`sftool` 烧不了（报错看起来像"进不去下载模式"）。
**烧之前先断开串口工具。**

```bash

```

1	#!/bin/bash
2	#
3	# 把工作区里的板级实现（board/contest_board）暴露给 openvela 构建树。
4	#
5	# 为什么不是整目录软链：
6	#   nuttx/CMakeLists.txt 里用
7	#       nuttx_create_symlink(${NUTTX_BOARD_ABS_DIR}/../drivers .../drivers/platform)
8	#   去找芯片侧驱动目录。如果 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 整个是软链，
9	#   那么 ".../sf32lb52_devkit_lcd/../drivers" 里的 ".." 会按 POSIX 规则
10	#   解析到**软链目标的父目录**（判题：board/），于是 drivers 找不到、
11	#   构建报 "drivers/platform/input/ft6146.c missing"。
12	#   所以 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 必须保持是「真目录」，只有里面的**每一项**是软链。

#!/bin/bash
#
# 把工作区里的板级实现（board/contest_board）暴露给 openvela 构建树。
#
# 为什么不是整目录软链：
#   nuttx/CMakeLists.txt 里用
#       nuttx_create_symlink(${NUTTX_BOARD_ABS_DIR}/../drivers .../drivers/platform)
#   去找芯片侧驱动目录。如果 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 整个是软链，
#   那么 ".../sf32lb52_devkit_lcd/../drivers" 里的 ".." 会按 POSIX 规则
#   解析到**软链目标的父目录**（判题：board/），于是 drivers 找不到、
#   构建报 "drivers/platform/input/ft6146.c missing"。
#   所以 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 必须保持是「真目录」，只有里面的**每一项**是软链。
#
# 什么时候要重跑：
#   `repo sync` 之后，vendor/sifli 这个子仓库可能把原始目录签回来，
#   覆盖掉这里的软链 —— 那就重跑一次本脚本。
#
# 用法：  bash board/contest_board/scripts/link_board_impl.sh
#
set -e

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"   # .../board/contest_board/scripts
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"                     # .../board/contest_board

# openvela 工作树：优先用环境变量，其次按常见布局猜
OPENVELA_DIR="${OPENVELA_DIR:-}"
if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ]; then
  # 常见布局：① 本仓库就在 openvela 工作树里（repo manifest 的 path 布局）
  #           ② 平级克隆（~/openvela）
  #           ③ 从本目录逐级向上找带 vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52 的目录
  #              （别人的工作区怎么放都能找到，不用手填 OPENVELA_DIR）
  for c in "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." "$HOME/openvela"; do
    if [ -d "$c/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then OPENVELA_DIR="$(cd "$c" && pwd)"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ]; then
  d="$BOARD_DIR"
  while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do
    if [ -d "$d/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then OPENVELA_DIR="$d"; break; fi
    d="$(dirname "$d")"
  done
fi

if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ] || [ ! -d "$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then
  echo "找不到 openvela 工作树；请用 OPENVELA_DIR=/path/to/openvela 指定" >&2
  exit 1
fi

DEST="$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/sf32lb52_devkit_lcd"
echo "board dir : $BOARD_DIR"
echo "openvela  : $OPENVELA_DIR"
echo "dest      : $DEST"

# 如果整目录本身是个软链，先拆掉（这是会破坏 ../drivers 的那个错误形态）
if [ -L "$DEST" ]; then
  echo "注意：$DEST 原本是整目录软链，先删除"
  rm -f "$DEST"
fi

mkdir -p "$DEST"

for e in CMakeLists.txt Kconfig README.md README_zh-cn.md configs include scripts src; do
  if [ -e "$BOARD_DIR/$e" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$BOARD_DIR/$e" "$DEST/$e"
    echo "  link $e"
  else
    echo "  !! 缺失 $e（跳过）" >&2
  fi
done

echo
echo "检查芯片驱动软链是否还能解析："
echo "  $(readlink "$OPENVELA_DIR/nuttx/drivers/platform" 2>/dev/null || echo '(无)')"
if [ -r "$OPENVELA_DIR/nuttx/drivers/platform/input/ft6146.c" ] || \
   [ -r "$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/drivers/input/ft6146.c" ]; then
  echo "  OK"
else
  echo "  !! drivers/platform 解析不到，构建会失败" >&2
  exit 1
fi

## 一、这次从照片 + 代码里拿到的判据

1. 你那张照片上的两个小方块（"08:05 / 70%" 和下面那个蓝色胶囊），**是我们的界面像素**：`08:05` 是状态栏时钟（`robot_ui.c:271-276`，白色 24px 居中），`70%` 是设置页那个百分比标签（`touch_ui.c:924` 的 `lv_label_set_text_fmt(value_label, "%d%%")`）。
2. 关键点是：**方块周围的黑色不是"变暗"，是面板 GRAM 里根本没写东西**。方块内部颜色/文字都对（说明 QSPI 数据通路、面板、亮度全是好的），只有"最近刚被重画过的那一小块"有内容。
3. 这跟 LVGL 的工作方式对得上：**LVGL 只重画脏区**。它认为"整屏我已经画好了"，就永远不会再画那些区域。
4. 于是问题变成：**为什么开机那次整屏首帧没进去？** 我在 `vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/drivers/lcd/sf32lb_lcd.c` 的刷新路径里找到了两个**静默丢帧**的口子：

```c
static int sf32lb_lcd_putrun/putarea(...)
{
  if (s_fb_registering || !s_lcd_hw_ready)
    {
      return OK;        /* ← 一个像素都不写，但报告"成功" */
    }
```

开机顺序是：`/dev/fb0` 先注册好 → 界面（robot_ui/LVGL）起来开始画 → 而面板要等 `lcd_hw_setup_thread_entry` 里**第二次完整 Init（拉 RESET + SWRESET + 重发寄存器，约 0.4 秒）**跑完才置 `s_lcd_hw_ready = true`。**LVGL 的整屏首帧正好落在这个窗口里，被整帧丢掉**，而它自己以为画上去了 → 之后只有零散小脏区会真的进屏。这也解释了"切页面就能看到新页面"（切页 = 大块脏区）。

**这也顺带解释了你的"烧录后黑、断电重启才有画面"**：这两种情况下 LVGL 起来和面板就绪的相对时机不一样（电源冷启动时面板/驱动的时序不同），落在窗口里就黑，落在窗口外就正常——所以它是**概率性**的，跟"重插有概率黑屏起不来"是同一件事。

 /****************************************************************************
+ * Name: sifli_uart_reinit_rx_dma
+ *
+ * Description:
+ *   非 static 的"把这一路 UART 的 RX DMA 重新装回去"入口（板级用）。
+ *
+ *   为什么需要它（2026-09-17 真机踩到）：本驱动**只在"上一次 DMA 传输完成"的
+ *   中断回调里**才会重新武装 RX（sifli_dma_receive）。而 DMAC1 上同时挂着本串口
+ *   （UART1 控制台 = DMA1_Channel6/7）和音频的 AUDPRC RX0 —— 板级音频恢复里那记
+ *   "复位整块 DMAC1"（RSTR1 的 DMAC1 位）会把这一路的通道配置一并抹掉，之后
+ *   DMA 永远不会完成 → receive() 永远不会再被调用 → **串口 RX 永久聋**（现象是
+ *   nsh 收不到任何命令，板子看起来"死了"，其实还在打日志）。
+ *
+ *   所以板级在复位完 DMAC1 之后必须调用本函数，把每一路 UART 的 RX DMA 重新
+ *   配置 + 重新启动接收。idx 用 sifli_uart.c 里的 UARTx_INDEX 枚举（0 起，
+ *   UART1 是 0）。
+ *
+ *   Returned Value:
+ *     0       装回去了
+ *     -EINVAL idx 越界或该路没配 RX DMA
+ *     -ENODEV 这一路还没 attach（priv 为空），不用管
+ ****************************************************************************/
+
+int sifli_uart_reinit_rx_dma(int idx)
+{
+    struct sifli_uart *uart;
+    int ret;
+
+    if (idx < 0 || idx >= UART_MAX)
+    {
+        return -EINVAL;
+    }
+
+    uart = &uart_obj[idx];
+
+    if (uart->serial.priv == NULL)
+    {
+        return -ENODEV;

sftool 0.2.5
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
#  Openvela flash helper for SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD (Linux)
#
#  KEY: the SFBL bootrom REQUIRES the partition table (ftab)
#       at 0x12000000, otherwise it will not boot the image.
#
#  Usage:  ./flash_openvela.sh [nuttx.bin] [serial-device]
#          (defaults: ./nuttx.bin, /dev/ttyUSB0)
# ============================================================
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

IMG="${1:-nuttx.bin}"
DEV="${2:-/dev/ttyUSB0}"

if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: firmware image not found: $IMG"
    echo "Put nuttx.bin here or pass it as the first argument."
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v sftool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: sftool not found. Install from"
    echo "  https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/releases  (0.2.5 recommended)"
    exit 1
fi

sftool -p "$DEV" -c SF32LB52 -m nor --before default_reset --after soft_reset \
    write_flash "ftab.bin@0x12000000" "$IMG@0x12010000"

echo "Done. Open serial at 1000000 8N1, expect: SFBL / ABCD / NuttShell (NSH)"

#!/bin/bash
#
# 把工作区里的板级实现（board/contest_board）暴露给 openvela 构建树。
#
# 为什么不是整目录软链：
#   nuttx/CMakeLists.txt 里用
#       nuttx_create_symlink(${NUTTX_BOARD_ABS_DIR}/../drivers .../drivers/platform)
#   去找芯片侧驱动目录。如果 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 整个是软链，
#   那么 ".../sf32lb52_devkit_lcd/../drivers" 里的 ".." 会按 POSIX 规则
#   解析到**软链目标的父目录**（判题：board/），于是 drivers 找不到、
#   构建报 "drivers/platform/input/ft6146.c missing"。
#   所以 sf32lb52_devkit_lcd 必须保持是「真目录」，只有里面的**每一项**是软链。
#
# 什么时候要重跑：
#   `repo sync` 之后，vendor/sifli 这个子仓库可能把原始目录签回来，
#   覆盖掉这里的软链 —— 那就重跑一次本脚本。
#
# 用法：  bash board/contest_board/scripts/link_board_impl.sh
#
set -e

HERE="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"   # .../board/contest_board/scripts
BOARD_DIR="$(cd "$HERE/.." && pwd)"                     # .../board/contest_board

# openvela 工作树：优先用环境变量，其次按常见布局猜
OPENVELA_DIR="${OPENVELA_DIR:-}"
if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ]; then
  # 常见布局：① 本仓库就在 openvela 工作树里（repo manifest 的 path 布局）
  #           ② 平级克隆（~/openvela）
  #           ③ 从本目录逐级向上找带 vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52 的目录
  #              （别人的工作区怎么放都能找到，不用手填 OPENVELA_DIR）
  for c in "$BOARD_DIR/../../../.." "$HOME/openvela"; do
    if [ -d "$c/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then OPENVELA_DIR="$(cd "$c" && pwd)"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ]; then
  d="$BOARD_DIR"
  while [ "$d" != "/" ]; do
    if [ -d "$d/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then OPENVELA_DIR="$d"; break; fi
    d="$(dirname "$d")"
  done
fi

if [ -z "$OPENVELA_DIR" ] || [ ! -d "$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52" ]; then
  echo "找不到 openvela 工作树；请用 OPENVELA_DIR=/path/to/openvela 指定" >&2
  exit 1
fi

DEST="$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/sf32lb52_devkit_lcd"
echo "board dir : $BOARD_DIR"
echo "openvela  : $OPENVELA_DIR"
echo "dest      : $DEST"

# 如果整目录本身是个软链，先拆掉（这是会破坏 ../drivers 的那个错误形态）
if [ -L "$DEST" ]; then
  echo "注意：$DEST 原本是整目录软链，先删除"
  rm -f "$DEST"
fi

mkdir -p "$DEST"

for e in CMakeLists.txt Kconfig README.md README_zh-cn.md configs include scripts src; do
  if [ -e "$BOARD_DIR/$e" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$BOARD_DIR/$e" "$DEST/$e"
    echo "  link $e"
  else
    echo "  !! 缺失 $e（跳过）" >&2
  fi
done

echo
echo "检查芯片驱动软链是否还能解析："
echo "  $(readlink "$OPENVELA_DIR/nuttx/drivers/platform" 2>/dev/null || echo '(无)')"
if [ -r "$OPENVELA_DIR/nuttx/drivers/platform/input/ft6146.c" ] || \
   [ -r "$OPENVELA_DIR/vendor/sifli/boards/sf32lb52/drivers/input/ft6146.c" ]; then
  echo "  OK"
else
  echo "  !! drivers/platform 解析不到，构建会失败" >&2
  exit 1
fi

#ifndef CONFIG_AUDIO_EXCLUDE_STOP
static int sf32lb52_audio_stop(FAR struct audio_lowerhalf_s *dev)
{
  FAR struct sf32lb52_audio_s *priv =
    (FAR struct sf32lb52_audio_s *)dev;
  int ret = sf32lb52_audio_hw_stop(priv);

  /* 停成功后必须替上层把 DRAINING 收掉（2026-10-10 真机定案）。
   *
   * 上层 audio_stop 在调下来**之前**就把共享的 upper->status->state 置成
   * AUDIO_STATE_DRAINING（nuttx/audio/audio.c:692），并且指望驱动用
   * AUDIO_CALLBACK_COMPLETE 通知它清掉（audio.c:1558-1561 会把 DRAINING
   * 落回 OPEN）。本板走 read()/write() 直通、从不走队列模式，那个回调全仓库
   * 没有路径发 —— 于是 DRAINING 只剩"最后一个 fd 被关"一条释放路
   * （audio.c:263-275，status 随之销毁重建）。
   *
   * 只要还有任何 app 持着 /dev/audio 的 fd（本板 robot_ui / hello_app /
   * 录音守护 / audio_test 都会各开各的），DRAINING 就会无限期钉着，之后
   * 每一个新会话的 CONFIGURE 与 START 都被上层**静默吞掉**：
   *   - CONFIGURE：state 不是 OPEN → 不调驱动 configure，照样返回 OK
   *     （audio.c:479-507）；
   *   - START：state 是 DRAINING → 不在 PREPARED/XRUN 分支 → 不调驱动
   *     start，照样返回 OK（audio.c:633-658）。
   * 现场（2026-10-10，烧录 1b89964b4 固件）：audio_test 播放
   * "START ret=0 → WRITE done: 0 of 96000"（write 进来 priv->running
   * 还是 0，3172 行静默返回 0）；录音守护 1.8 秒一轮
   * "AUDIO_IN: started → read 立刻 -ENODEV(running=0) → stop → 重开"，
   * 麦克风喇叭同时全聋，ioctls 却全部"成功"——和本注释描述的闭环完全一致。
   *
   * 修法：STOP 是上层唯一会进来的、且此刻 DRAINING 刚被置上的入口，在
   * hw_stop 成功后补一记 COMPLETE，让状态立刻落回 OPEN，下一个会话的
   * CONFIGURE/START 就能真进驱动。audio_complete 里除清状态外只会往
   * mq 发一条消息 —— 本板没人给音频注册 mq，是空操作；且它设计上就
   * 允许在驱动上下文（含中断）调用，这里在 ioctl 线程里调没有问题。
   * 失败时不发：上层收到非 OK 会把状态还原（audio.c:698-701），我们
   * 再发一记 COMPLETE 反而会把还没停掉的会话状态清错。 */

  if (ret == OK && priv->dev.upper != NULL)
    {
      priv->dev.upper(priv->dev.priv, AUDIO_CALLBACK_COMPLETE, NULL, OK);
    }

  return ret;
}
#endif

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# ============================================================
#  Openvela flash helper for SF32LB52-DevKit-LCD (Linux)
#
#  KEY: the SFBL bootrom REQUIRES the partition table (ftab)
#       at 0x12000000, otherwise it will not boot the image.
#
#  Usage:  ./flash_openvela.sh [nuttx.bin] [serial-device]
#          (defaults: ./nuttx.bin, /dev/ttyUSB0)
# ============================================================
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

IMG="${1:-nuttx.bin}"
DEV="${2:-/dev/ttyUSB0}"

if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: firmware image not found: $IMG"
    echo "Put nuttx.bin here or pass it as the first argument."
    exit 1
fi

if ! command -v sftool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "ERROR: sftool not found. Install from"
    echo "  https://github.com/OpenSiFli/sftool/releases  (0.2.5 recommended)"
    exit 1
fi

sftool -p "$DEV" -c SF32LB52 -m nor --before default_reset --after soft_reset \
    write_flash "ftab.bin@0x12000000" "$IMG@0x12010000"

echo "Done. Open serial at 1000000 8N1, expect: SFBL / ABCD / NuttShell (NSH)"

## 排查结论：不是麦克风/喇叭硬件坏了，是软件把整个音频设备"锁聋"了

这次你没听到测试音的第二次播放，恰好帮我锁定了根因——播放的 `write` 返回了 **0 of 96000 字节**（一个字节都没进硬件），和录音的 `-ENODEV` 是同一个病。完整链条：

1. **NuttX 音频上层有个 DRAINING 状态**：每次 `AUDIOIOC_STOP` 成功后，上层把设备状态置成 DRAINING，指望驱动回调 `AUDIO_CALLBACK_COMPLETE` 来清掉它（[audio.c:1558-1561](openvela/nuttx/audio/audio.c#L1558-L1561)）。
2. **本板驱动从不发这个回调**（板子走 read/write 直通，不走队列模式），DRAINING 只剩"最后一个 fd 被关"一条出路。而板上 robot_ui、hello_app、录音守护各开各的 fd——只要还有一个 fd 开着，DRAINING 就**无限期钉死**。
3. 钉死之后，每个新会话的 CONFIGURE/START 都被上层**静默吞掉**：返回成功，但驱动一次都没被调用。于是：
   - 录音守护：`started`（假的）→ `read` 发现 `running=0` → `-ENODEV` → stop → 重开……**1.8 秒死循环**（你串口里刷屏的就是它）
   - 播放：`START ret=0`（假的）→ `write` 发现 `running=0` → 静默返回 0 字节——**所以刚才测试音没声，跟音量、功放、硬件都无关**

**修复**（已改 [sf32lb52_audio.c](openvela/contest2026_233_daimazenmepaibudui/board/contest_board/src/sf32lb52_audio.c) 的 stop 入口，编译通过）：驱动停成功后补发 `AUDIO_CALLBACK_COMPLETE`，让 DRAINING 立刻释放，下一个会话的 CONFIGURE/START 就能真进驱动。这也解释了队友之前"时好时坏"的现场记录——fd 恰好没人持有时就能恢复。

#!/bin/bash
# 板子 RNDIS 网卡接进虚拟机后的一次性网络配置
# 1) 手动把 NuttX RNDIS gadget 绑到 rndis_host（枚举早于模块加载时内核不会重试）
# 2) 给 usb0 配 192.168.137.1/24（板侧固定 192.168.137.2）
# 3) 开 IP 转发 + NAT，把板子的流量从 ens33 送出去
set -e

echo "== 1. 找到 NuttX RNDIS gadget =="
DEV=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/devices/* 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
  [ "$(cat "$d/idVendor" 2>/dev/null)" = "584e" ] && basename "$d" && break
done)
if [ -z "$DEV" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: lsusb 里找不到 584e:5342，请先在 VMware 里把板子原生 USB 连接到虚拟机"
  exit 1
fi
echo "设备: $DEV"

echo "== 2. 绑定 rndis_host =="
if [ -d "/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/${DEV}:1.0" ]; then
  echo "已经绑好，跳过"
else
  # 先按接口绑；失败就让 rndis_host 认领整台设备（584e 5342）
  if echo "${DEV}:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/bind 2>/tmp/bind_err.txt; then
    echo "按接口绑定成功"
  else
    echo "按接口绑定失败: $(cat /tmp/bind_err.txt)，改用 new_id 认领整机"
    echo "584e 5342" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id
  fi
  sleep 1
fi

IFACE=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/*/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "${DEV}:[0-9.]+$" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ | grep -E "^usb[0-9]|^enx" | head -1)
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  # 常见情况：驱动绑上后接口名要等几拍
  sleep 2
  NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ | grep -E "^usb[0-9]|^enx" | head -1)
fi
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: 绑定后仍没有出现网卡，看看 dmesg | tail -20"
  exit 1
fi
echo "网卡: $NETIF"

echo "== 3. 配 IP 并拉起 =="
ip addr flush dev "$NETIF" 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev "$NETIF"
ip link set "$NETIF" up

echo "== 4. 转发 + NAT（出口 ens33） =="
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
# 幂等：先清同款旧规则再加
iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o ens33 -j MASQUERADE 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o ens33 -j MASQUERADE
iptables -D FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o ens33 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -A FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o ens33 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D FORWARD -i ens33 -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -A FORWARD -i ens33 -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

echo "== 5. 验证 =="
ip -br addr show "$NETIF"
ping -c 2 -W 2 192.168.137.2 && echo "PING 板子 OK" || echo "PING 板子失败（板侧 RNDIS 可能还没起来，看板上串口）"
echo "ALL DONE"

#!/bin/bash
# 重新触发 RNDIS probe：先从驱动解绑，再重新绑一次
set -e
DEV=1-2.3
echo "== 当前绑定状态 =="
ls /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/ | grep -E "^[0-9]" || echo "(无)"

echo "== 解绑 =="
echo "${DEV}:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/unbind 2>/dev/null || echo "(本来就没绑)"
echo "${DEV}:1.1" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/unbind 2>/dev/null || true

echo "== 重新绑定 =="
if echo "${DEV}:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/bind; then
  echo "绑定调用成功"
else
  echo "绑定仍然被拒（内核会记 probe 失败原因）"
fi
sleep 2

echo "== 结果 =="
ip -br link show | grep -vE "lo|ens33" || echo "没有新网卡"
echo "== 最近内核日志 =="
journalctl -k --no-pager -n 8 | grep -iE "rndis|usbnet" || true

#!/bin/bash
# 板子 RNDIS 网卡接进虚拟机后的一次性网络配置
# 1) 手动把 NuttX RNDIS gadget 绑到 rndis_host（枚举早于模块加载时内核不会重试）
# 2) 给 usb0 配 192.168.137.1/24（板侧固定 192.168.137.2）
# 3) 开 IP 转发 + NAT，把板子的流量从 ens33 送出去
set -e

echo "== 1. 找到 NuttX RNDIS gadget =="
DEV=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/devices/* 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
  [ "$(cat "$d/idVendor" 2>/dev/null)" = "584e" ] && basename "$d" && break
done)
if [ -z "$DEV" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: lsusb 里找不到 584e:5342，请先在 VMware 里把板子原生 USB 连接到虚拟机"
  exit 1
fi
echo "设备: $DEV"

echo "== 2. 绑定 rndis_host =="
if [ -d "/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/${DEV}:1.0" ]; then
  echo "已经绑好，跳过"
else
  # 先按接口绑；失败就让 rndis_host 认领整台设备（584e 5342）
  if echo "${DEV}:1.0" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/bind 2>/tmp/bind_err.txt; then
    echo "按接口绑定成功"
  else
    echo "按接口绑定失败: $(cat /tmp/bind_err.txt)，改用 new_id 认领整机"
    echo "584e 5342" > /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id
  fi
  sleep 1
fi

IFACE=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/*/ 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "${DEV}:[0-9.]+$" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ | grep -E "^usb[0-9]|^enx" | head -1)
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  # 常见情况：驱动绑上后接口名要等几拍
  sleep 2
  NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ | grep -E "^usb[0-9]|^enx" | head -1)
fi
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: 绑定后仍没有出现网卡，看看 dmesg | tail -20"
  exit 1
fi
echo "网卡: $NETIF"

echo "== 3. 配 IP 并拉起 =="
ip addr flush dev "$NETIF" 2>/dev/null || true
ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev "$NETIF"
ip link set "$NETIF" up

echo "== 4. 转发 + NAT（出口 ens33） =="
sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1
# 幂等：先清同款旧规则再加
iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o ens33 -j MASQUERADE 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o ens33 -j MASQUERADE
iptables -D FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o ens33 -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -A FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o ens33 -j ACCEPT
iptables -D FORWARD -i ens33 -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
iptables -A FORWARD -i ens33 -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

echo "== 5. 验证 =="
ip -br addr show "$NETIF"
ping -c 2 -W 2 192.168.137.2 && echo "PING 板子 OK" || echo "PING 板子失败（板侧 RNDIS 可能还没起来，看板上串口）"
echo "ALL DONE"

usbnet_probe flow for rndis_host:
1. `info = prod->driver_info` — for our dynid match "584e 5342" vendor/product-only: **WHAT driver_info does a DYNID match carry?!**

CRITICAL INSIGHT!!! The dynid added via `echo "584e 5342" > new_id` creates a usb_device_id with ONLY vendor/product matched and **driver_info = 0** (userspace can't set driver_info)! Look at probe:

```c
	info = (const struct driver_info *) prod->driver_info;
	if (!info) {
		dev_dbg (&udev->dev, "blacklisted by %s\n", name);
		return -ENODEV; // ← line 1754
	}
```

**If the match came from the DYNID (new_id), prod->driver_info == 0 → probe returns -ENODEV immediately with only a dev_dbg (invisible without dynamic debug)!**

BUT — usb_device_match / usb_match_id: which id does probe receive? usbnet_probe receives `prod` = the id from the match. In usbcore's probe wrapper (usb_probe_interface):

```c
static int usb_probe_interface(struct device *dev)
{
	...
	id = usb_match_dynamic_id(intf, udriver) ?:
	     usb_match_id(intf, udriver->id_table);
	error = udriver->probe(intf, id);
```

**usb_match_dynamic_id is checked FIRST!** Since our dynid "584e 5342" is registered, EVERY probe gets id = dynid (driver_info=0) → -ENODEV immediately, EVEN IF the static products[] would have matched with proper rndis_info!!! 

And for AUTO-probe (no manual bind): device_attach → usb_device_match → ... → really_probe → usb_probe_interface → same: **usb_match_dynamic_id FIRST** → dynid wins over static table → probe gets driver_info=0 → -ENODEV silently → **auto-probe "fails invisibly" every time**!!! 

THIS EXPLAINS EVERYTHING:
- Original OHCI era: at first, NO dynid existed → static match (USB_INTERFACE_INFO 02/02/FF → rndis_info) → probe proceeded to rndis_command → "RNDIS init failed, -32" (device stalled the control msg — possibly VMware OHCI issue, or gadget not ready).
- Then I told user to add new_id "584e 5342" as a "fallback" — **that BROKE all subsequent probes** by shadowing the static id with driver_info=0!
- All later auto-probes and manual binds → instant silent -ENODEV.
- The -19 ENODEV on `echo 3-2:1.0 > bind`: bind_store → match OK (dynid) → device_driver_attach → usbnet_probe returns -ENODEV (driver_info=0) → propagated!

Verify with kernel source: usb_probe_interface in v7.0 drivers/usb/core/driver.c:
```c
	id = usb_match_dynamic_id(intf, udriver) ?:
		usb_match_id(intf, udriver->id_table);
```
Yes, that's been the code for years. CONFIRMED mechanism.

**THE FIX: remove the dynid from rndis_host's new_id, then re-trigger probe.** 

Problem: how to remove a dynid?? There's no sysfs file to remove individual dynids... The dynid list is in-module; sysfs only has new_id (add). To CLEAR dynids: **unload/reload the module** (rmmod rndis_host; modprobe rndis_host). Is rndis_host a module or built-in? Check: /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/ has no "module" symlink → built-in → can't rmmod!! Damn.

Check first: `ls -la /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/` for a "module" symlink. If built-in, dynids persist until reboot. UGH. The user's VM would need a REBOOT to clear the dynid... rebooting the VM is disruptive but totally doable (user controls the VM; it's their machine, VMware session). After VM reboot: fresh kernel, no dynids, device re-enumerates at boot or on replug, static match 02/02/FF → rndis_info → probe → rndis_command → RNDIS init (may hit the -32 stall issue again IF that was real, but the -32 was on OHCI — on xHCI we never got that far!).

Wait — also reconsider the OHCI -32: was it maybe also dynid-related? No — the -32 message "RNDIS init failed, -32" comes from generic_rndis_bind AFTER usbnet_generic_cdc_bind succeeded — that means driver_info was NON-zero back then (no dynid yet, static match). The -32 was a real control-transfer stall from the device (or VMware). That was on OHCI (USB1.1 controller). Now with xHCI 3.1, control transfers work fine for enumeration. The RNDIS init control request might work on xHCI — OR the -32 was a genuine board-side stall (STALLEDISPATCH in sf32lb_usbdev.c), independent of host controller.

Plan:
1. Verify rndis_host is a module or built-in (check for /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/module symlink or /sys/module/rndis_host).
2a. If MODULE: rmmod rndis_host && modprobe rndis_host (dynid list dies with module unload), then trigger reprobe (authorized toggle or just bind). NO VM REBOOT NEEDED.
2b. If BUILT-IN: dynid persists → needs VM reboot. OR alternative: **use a driver_override**?? No — override doesn't set driver_info either. Hmm — actually wait, is there any OTHER way to trigger a probe with the STATIC id?? usb_probe_interface ALWAYS checks dynid first. No way around it without clearing dynids. VM reboot it is (user can reboot the VM — VMware makes this easy; board stays powered via its own supply, will re-enumerate after VM comes back).

Actually — hold on, one more check on usb_match_dynamic_id semantics: does the dynid really override, or is static checked first? Source (drivers/usb/core/driver.c, usb_probe_interface, stable for years):

```c
	id = usb_match_dynamic_id(intf, udriver) ?:
		usb_match_id(intf, udriver->id_table);
```

Dynid FIRST. Confirmed from memory + this is stable code. But let me VERIFY against v7.0 since I'm fetching files anyway. Also verify usbnet probe's driver_info check is at the top (already saw line 1754: `if (!info) return -ENODEV` with dev_dbg only — SILENT). 

Also double-check: does writing new_id with just "vendor product" really create driver_info=0? usb_store_new_id parses idVendor, idProduct (+ optional bcdDeviceLo/Hi, class/subclass/protocol). driver_info field is not settable from userspace → 0. Confirmed.

So sequence for the user:
1. Check if rndis_host is module: `ls /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/module` — if exists (module):

input.command:
cd /tmp && python3 -c "
import serial, time
ser = serial.Serial('/dev/ttyACM1', 1000000, timeout=0.3)

def drain(t):
    time.sleep(t)
    return ser.read(ser.in_waiting or 1).decode(errors='replace')

def send(cmd, wait=2.0, tries=4):
    for k in range(tries):
        ser.write(b'\r'); drain(0.2)
        ser.write((cmd + '\r').encode())
        out = drain(wait)
        # 判断：命令回显出现且带结果特征
        if cmd.split()[0] in out and any(f in out for f in ('Link','enc','inet','flags','MTU','HWaddr')):
            return out
    return out

out = send('ifconfig')
ser.close()
import re
# 去掉 ANSI 控制符再过滤
clean = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;?]*[A-Za-z]', '', out)
keep = []
for line in clean.splitlines():
    s = line.strip()
    if not s or s.startswith('[ui]') or 'LCDMIRROR' in s or 'MQTT' in s or 'TCP connect' in s or 'Error 101' in s or s.startswith('[AI_NET') or s == 'nsh>' or s == 'nsh> ifconfig':
        continue
    keep.append(s)
print('\n'.join(keep[:60]))
"

#!/bin/bash
# 板子 RNDIS 网络一键恢复（虚拟机重启/重插 USB 后跑一次即可）
#
# 背景与禁忌（2026-10-11 真机定案）：
# - 板子固件 = NuttX RNDIS gadget 584e:5342，Linux rndis_host 静态 id_table
#   本来就认得它（USB_INTERFACE_INFO 02/02/ff），枚举后会自动绑定，正常情况下
#   什么都不用做。
# - ⛔ 千万不要往 /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id 写任何东西！
#   new_id 注册的 dynid driver_info 恒为 0，且匹配优先级高于静态表，会让
#   usbnet_probe 开头 `if (!info) return -ENODEV` 静默失败——中招后每次探测
#  都无声无息，只能 rmmod rndis_host 清掉。
# - 板侧固定 192.168.137.2，主机侧固定 192.168.137.1，DNS 223.5.5.5（编译期配置）。
set -e

echo "== 1. 等待板子出现 =="
DEV=""
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  DEV=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/devices/* 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
    [ "$(cat "$d/idVendor" 2>/dev/null)" = "584e" ] && basename "$d" && break
  done)
  [ -n "$DEV" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$DEV" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: 找不到 584e:5342（板子未上电 / USB 未接到虚拟机）"
  exit 1
fi
echo "设备: $DEV"

echo "== 2. 等待 rndis_host 自动绑定（不要手动 new_id！） =="
NETIF=""
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^enx|^usb[0-9]" | head -1)
  [ -n "$NETIF" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  echo "自动绑定未出现网卡。查 journalctl -k | grep -i rndis 看原因。"
  echo "若是历史 new_id 残留导致：sudo rmmod rndis_host && sudo modprobe rndis_host"
  exit 1
fi
echo "网卡: $NETIF"

echo "== 3. IP + 转发 + NAT（出口网卡自动检测） =="
GW_DEV=$(ip route show default | awk '/default/ {print $5; exit}')
echo "互联网出口: $GW_DEV"
sudo ip addr flush dev "$NETIF" 2>/dev/null || true
sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev "$NETIF"
sudo ip link set "$NETIF" up
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 >/dev/null
# 幂等：先删同款旧规则再加
sudo iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o "$GW_DEV" -j MASQUERADE 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o "$GW_DEV" -j MASQUERADE
sudo iptables -D FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o "$GW_DEV" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -A FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o "$GW_DEV" -j ACCEPT
sudo iptables -D FORWARD -i "$GW_DEV" -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -A FORWARD -i "$GW_DEV" -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

echo "== 4. 验证 =="
ip -br addr show "$NETIF"
ping -c 2 -W 2 192.168.137.2 && echo "PING 板子 OK —— 网络就绪" || echo "PING 板子失败（板侧 RNDIS netif 可能还没配 IP，看板上串口）"

2. **The display backlight got turned off** — power management? The app has a UI; if it crashed early before display init, screen stays dark. Did the app crash? If NSH were reachable we'd see... serial is unplugged. 
3. **The screen was ALWAYS driven by the UI app; if the app crashed/hung at boot, LCD stays in its reset state (dark)**. What could crash the app on this boot? The audio fix? No — that's been running for a day fine. A fresh boot after our... we didn't flash anything new! The firmware on flash is still the old one (audio fix build from Oct 10). Reset just re-runs it. It booted fine many times today.
4. **LCD ribbon/backlight connector got nudged during the physical handling** (user pressed reset / moved the board — the display flex cable came loose!). Very plausible: user physically handled the board; SF32LB52 dev boards have fragile FPC connectors.
5. The board might boot to a different boot reason path: sf32lb52_log_boot_reason / lchspi_ulp_bringup — "只允许调一次（读一次就把 PMU 里的标志清掉）" — ULP boot reason! If the board entered a LOW-POWER boot path (PMU flag), it might skip normal app bring-up!! The reset via the button should be a normal cold/warm reset though.
6. **Charging/power**: USB enumerating =5V present. Fine.

Crucial next diagnostic: is the APP running? Without serial... I can probe over the NETWORK! The board re-enumerated — is rndis_host bound? Did the netif come back? Check journalctl for the new enumeration (Device 010) — probe result. And ping 192.168.137.2 (needs host IP configured — my rndis_net_up... the host-side config from earlier is still in place? The enx interface may still have 192.168.137.1 — the VM didn't reboot. Check `ip addr show` — read-only OK).

If the board answers ping → full app + network up → LCD is just a display/connector/backlight issue (or UI task crashed while net stack alive — actually ping is answered by the NET STACK not the app! NuttX net stack runs independently of the UI app. So ping OK only proves netif up).
Better app-liveness probe: **port 5600!** The LCDMIRROR app connects out to 192.168.137.1:5600 every 2.5s. If the APP is running, as soon as I listen on 5600 I get a connection. That tests the APP (hello_app/robot_ui main loop), not just the net stack!

So plan:
1. Check journalctl for the fresh probe (did rndis_host bind after reboot?)
2. Check host interface IP still there
3. Start5600 listener briefly → if board connects → APP alive → screen dark is display-side (connector/backlight/panel), not software

#!/bin/bash
# 板子 RNDIS 网络一键恢复（虚拟机重启/重插 USB 后跑一次即可）
#
# 背景与禁忌（2026-10-11 真机定案）：
# - 板子固件 = NuttX RNDIS gadget 584e:5342，Linux rndis_host 静态 id_table
#   本来就认得它（USB_INTERFACE_INFO 02/02/ff），枚举后会自动绑定，正常情况下
#   什么都不用做。
# - ⛔ 千万不要往 /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id 写任何东西！
#   new_id 注册的 dynid driver_info 恒为 0，且匹配优先级高于静态表，会让
#   usbnet_probe 开头 `if (!info) return -ENODEV` 静默失败——中招后每次探测
#  都无声无息，只能 rmmod rndis_host 清掉。
# - 板侧固定 192.168.137.2，主机侧固定 192.168.137.1，DNS 223.5.5.5（编译期配置）。
set -e

echo "== 1. 等待板子出现 =="
DEV=""
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  DEV=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/devices/* 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
    [ "$(cat "$d/idVendor" 2>/dev/null)" = "584e" ] && basename "$d" && break
  done)
  [ -n "$DEV" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$DEV" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: 找不到 584e:5342（板子未上电 / USB 未接到虚拟机）"
  exit 1
fi
echo "设备: $DEV"

echo "== 2. 等待 rndis_host 自动绑定（不要手动 new_id！） =="
NETIF=""
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^enx|^usb[0-9]" | head -1)
  [ -n "$NETIF" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  echo "自动绑定未出现网卡。查 journalctl -k | grep -i rndis 看原因。"
  echo "若是历史 new_id 残留导致：sudo rmmod rndis_host && sudo modprobe rndis_host"
  exit 1
fi
echo "网卡: $NETIF"

echo "== 3. IP + 转发 + NAT（出口网卡自动检测） =="
GW_DEV=$(ip route show default | awk '/default/ {print $5; exit}')
echo "互联网出口: $GW_DEV"
sudo ip addr flush dev "$NETIF" 2>/dev/null || true
sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev "$NETIF"
sudo ip link set "$NETIF" up

# 板子 RNDIS 网络一键恢复（虚拟机重启/重插 USB 后跑一次即可）
#
# 背景与禁忌（2026-10-11 真机定案）：
# - 板子固件 = NuttX RNDIS gadget 584e:5342，Linux rndis_host 静态 id_table
#   本来就认得它（USB_INTERFACE_INFO 02/02/ff），枚举后会自动绑定，正常情况下
#   什么都不用做。
# - ⛔ 千万不要往 /sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id 写任何东西！
#   new_id 注册的 dynid driver_info 恒为 0，且匹配优先级高于静态表，会让
#   usbnet_probe 开头 `if (!info) return -ENODEV` 静默失败——中招后每次探测
#  都无声无息，只能 rmmod rndis_host 清掉。
# - 板侧固定 192.168.137.2，主机侧固定 192.168.137.1，DNS 223.5.5.5（编译期配置）。
set -e

echo "== 1. 等待板子出现 =="
DEV=""
for i in $(seq 1 15); do
  DEV=$(ls -d /sys/bus/usb/devices/* 2>/dev/null | while read d; do
    [ "$(cat "$d/idVendor" 2>/dev/null)" = "584e" ] && basename "$d" && break
  done)
  [ -n "$DEV" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$DEV" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: 找不到 584e:5342（板子未上电 / USB 未接到虚拟机）"
  exit 1
fi
echo "设备: $DEV"

echo "== 2. 等待 rndis_host 自动绑定（不要手动 new_id！） =="
NETIF=""
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  NETIF=$(ls /sys/class/net/ 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^enx|^usb[0-9]" | head -1)
  [ -n "$NETIF" ] && break
  sleep 1
done
if [ -z "$NETIF" ]; then
  echo "自动绑定未出现网卡。查 journalctl -k | grep -i rndis 看原因。"
  echo "若是历史 new_id 残留导致：sudo rmmod rndis_host && sudo modprobe rndis_host"
  exit 1
fi
echo "网卡: $NETIF"

echo "== 3. IP + 转发 + NAT（出口网卡自动检测） =="
GW_DEV=$(ip route show default | awk '/default/ {print $5; exit}')
echo "互联网出口: $GW_DEV"
sudo ip addr flush dev "$NETIF" 2>/dev/null || true
sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev "$NETIF"
sudo ip link set "$NETIF" up
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 >/dev/null
# 幂等：先删同款旧规则再加
sudo iptables -t nat -D POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o "$GW_DEV" -j MASQUERADE 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -t nat -A POSTROUTING -s 192.168.137.0/24 -o "$GW_DEV" -j MASQUERADE
sudo iptables -D FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o "$GW_DEV" -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -A FORWARD -i "$NETIF" -o "$GW_DEV" -j ACCEPT
sudo iptables -D FORWARD -i "$GW_DEV" -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT 2>/dev/null || true
sudo iptables -A FORWARD -i "$GW_DEV" -o "$NETIF" -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

echo "== 4. 验证 =="
ip -br addr show "$NETIF"
ping -c 2 -W 2 192.168.137.2 && echo "PING 板子 OK —— 网络就绪" || echo "PING 板子失败（板侧 RNDIS netif 可能还没配 IP，看板上串口）"

description: 板子联网架构（RNDIS over USB）与 rndis_host new_id 毒化禁忌；恢复脚本在 ~/rndis_net_up.sh

openvela 比赛板（SF32LB52, contest2026_233）联网走 **USB RNDIS**：板侧固件固定 192.168.137.2、网关 192.168.137.1、DNS 223.5.5.5（编译期配置，不依赖 CONFIG_NETINIT，板上 netinit 未开）；VMware 虚拟机主机侧网卡 `enx00e04c534231`（MAC 00:e0:4c:53:42:31 = 固件 rndis_mac）配 192.168.137.1/24 + iptables MASQUERADE 出口 ens33（后改为自动检测出口）。2026-10-11 已实测全通：ping、板子→主机 TCP(:5600 LCDMIRROR)、板子→broker.emqx.io:1883 MQTT（30s 心跳 + diag RPC）。

**Why:** 主机重启/重插 USB 后网络会丢；曾踩坑 new_id 毒化排查了一整晚。

**How to apply:** 恢复网络直接跑 `~/rndis_net_up.sh`（自动找设备、绑卡、配 NAT）。⛔ 永远不要往 `/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id` 写 ID——dynid 的 driver_info=0 且优先级高于静态表，会让 usbnet_probe 静默返回 -ENODEV；静态表本来就认 584e:5342（接口 02/02/ff），枚举即自动绑定。若已中招：`sudo rmmod rndis_host; sudo modprobe rndis_host`。板子串口 = CH343(1a86:55d3) @1000000，设备号随枚举漂移（ACM0/ACM1），用 udev 规则 99-ch343.rules 保权限；板子无软件 reboot 命令（CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET 未开）。⚠️ 物理"复位键"不等于断电重启：2026-10-11 按复位后屏幕黑、应用没起、RNDIS QUERY 仍 stall（疑似走了 PMU 低功耗启动分支，见 sifli_ap.c 的 boot_reason/ULP 路径）；**重启板子一律用拔电-等3秒-插回的冷启动**，冷启动后 rndis_host 首次探测即自动绑定。板子 USB 重连（不冷启动）时 QUERY 可能因响应队列残留被 stall——已在 nuttx/drivers/usbdev/rndis.c INIT 分支加清队列补丁（2026-10-11 已编译待烧录）。相关：[[sf32lb52-audio-drain-fix]]

脚本和记忆都已加固。总结一下这次的完整因果链，方便你以后排查同类问题：

| 时间 | 事件 |
|---|---|
| 17:28 | 板子冷启动，rndis_host 自动绑定成功 |
| ~17:35 | `rndis_net_up.sh` 配好 192.168.137.1 + NAT，ping 通 |

| 17:47 | DHCP 45 秒无租约、激活失败 → 网卡无地址、137 直连路由消失 |
| 之后 | 板子发包 L2 直达主机还能看见，主机回包全被默认路由甩进 ens33 蒸发 → 板子 UI 未联网、MQTT 重传死循环 |

上面那两条命令（`nmcli managed no` + 重新加 IP）执行完，按 3 步判断标准验收即可。如果 ping 通了但板子 UI 还差一口气，等它的 MQTT 重传超时（一般 30–60 秒）或 10 秒补连周期，不用动板子。

The user tried to open the serial port with picocom but got "cannot lock /dev/ttyACM0: Resource temporarily unavailable" — meaning another process is holding the port. What process could it be? openvela 比赛板（SF32LB52, contest2026_233）联网走 **USB RNDIS**：板侧固件固定 192.168.137.2、网关 192.168.137.1、DNS 223.5.5.5（编译期配置，不依赖 CONFIG_NETINIT，板上 netinit 未开）；VMware 虚拟机主机侧网卡 `enx00e04c534231`（MAC 00:e0:4c:53:42:31 = 固件 rndis_mac）配 192.168.137.1/24 + iptables MASQUERADE 出口 ens33（后改为自动检测出口）。2026-10-11 已实测全通：ping、板子→主机 TCP(:5600 LCDMIRROR)、板子→broker.emqx.io:1883 MQTT（30s 心跳 + diag RPC）。

**Why:** 主机重启/重插 USB 后网络会丢；曾踩坑 new_id 毒化排查了一整晚。

**How to apply:** 恢复网络直接跑 `~/rndis_net_up.sh`（自动找设备、绑卡、配 NAT，脚本已内置 `nmcli managed no`）。⚠️ NetworkManager 会抢管 enx 网卡并用预置 DHCP 连接「有线连接 1」刷掉静态 IP（2026-10-11 17:46 复现：配好 11 分钟后被刷，DHCP 无租约失败后网卡无地址，137 直连路由消失 → 主机回包全走默认路由进 NAT 蒸发，板子能发不能收、UI 未联网）；`ip route get 192.168.137.2` 若显示 `dev ens33` 即中招，修复 = `sudo nmcli device set enx... managed no` + `sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev enx...`，不用重启板子。⛔ 永远不要往 `/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id` 写 ID——dynid 的 driver_info=0 且优先级高于静态表，会让 usbnet_probe 静默返回 -ENODEV；静态表本来就认 584e:5342（接口 02/02/ff），枚举即自动绑定。若已中招：`sudo rmmod rndis_host; sudo modprobe rndis_host`。板子串口 = CH343(1a86:55d3) @1000000，设备号随枚举漂移（ACM0/ACM1），用 udev 规则 99-ch343.rules 保权限；板子无软件 reboot 命令（CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET 未开）。⚠️ 物理"复位键"不等于断电重启：2026-10-11 按复位后屏幕黑、应用没起、RNDIS QUERY 仍 stall（疑似走了 PMU 低功耗启动分支，见 sifli_ap.c 的 boot_reason/ULP 路径）；**重启板子一律用拔电-等3秒-插回的冷启动**，冷启动后 rndis_host 首次探测即自动绑定。板子 USB 重连（不冷启动）时 QUERY 可能因响应队列残留被 stall——已在 nuttx/drivers/usbdev/rndis.c INIT 分支加清队列补丁（2026-10-11 已编译待烧录）。相关：[[sf32lb52-audio-drain-fix]]

-**How to apply:** 恢复网络直接跑 `~/rndis_net_up.sh`（自动找设备、绑卡、配 NAT，脚本已内置 `nmcli managed no`）。⚠️ NetworkManager 会抢管 enx 网卡并用预置 DHCP 连接「有线连接 1」刷掉静态 IP（2026-10-11 17:46 复现：配好 11 分钟后被刷，DHCP 无租约失败后网卡无地址，137 直连路由消失 → 主机回包全走默认路由进 NAT 蒸发，板子能发不能收、UI 未联网）；`ip route get 192.168.137.2` 若显示 `dev ens33` 即中招，修复 = `sudo nmcli device set enx... managed no` + `sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev enx...`，不用重启板子。⛔ 永远不要往 `/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id` 写 ID——dynid 的 driver_info=0 且优先级高于静态表，会让 usbnet_probe 静默返回 -ENODEV；静态表本来就认 584e:5342（接口 02/02/ff），枚举即自动绑定。若已中招：`sudo rmmod rndis_host; sudo modprobe rndis_host`。板子串口 = CH343(1a86:55d3) @1000000，设备号随枚举漂移（ACM0/ACM1），用 udev 规则 99-ch343.rules 保权限；板子无软件 reboot 命令（CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET 未开）。⚠️ 物理"复位键"不等于断电重启：2026-10-11 按复位后屏幕黑、应用没起、RNDIS QUERY 仍 stall（疑似走了 PMU 低功耗启动分支，见 sifli_ap.c 的 boot_reason/ULP 路径）；**重启板子一律用拔电-等3秒-插回的冷启动**，冷启动后 rndis_host 首次探测即自动绑定。板子 USB 重连（不冷启动）时 QUERY 可能因响应队列残留被 stall——已在 nuttx/drivers/usbdev/rndis.c INIT 分支加清队列补丁（2026-10-11 已编译待烧录）。相关：[[sf32lb52-audio-drain-fix]]

+**How to apply:** 恢复网络直接跑 `~/rndis_net_up.sh`（自动找设备、绑卡、配 NAT，脚本已内置 `nmcli managed no`）。⚠️ NetworkManager 会抢管 enx 网卡并用预置 DHCP 连接「有线连接 1」刷掉静态 IP（2026-10-11 17:46 复现：配好 11 分钟后被刷，DHCP 无租约失败后网卡无地址，137 直连路由消失 → 主机回包全走默认路由进 NAT 蒸发，板子能发不能收、UI 未联网）；`ip route get 192.168.137.2` 若显示 `dev ens33` 即中招，修复 = `sudo nmcli device set enx... managed no` + `sudo ip addr add 192.168.137.1/24 dev enx...`，不用重启板子。⛔ 永远不要往 `/sys/bus/usb/drivers/rndis_host/new_id` 写 ID——dynid 的 driver_info=0 且优先级高于静态表，会让 usbnet_probe 静默返回 -ENODEV；静态表本来就认 584e:5342（接口 02/02/ff），枚举即自动绑定。若已中招：`sudo rmmod rndis_host; sudo modprobe rndis_host`。板子串口 = CH343(1a86:55d3) @1000000，设备号随枚举漂移（ACM0/ACM1），用 udev 规则 99-ch343.rules 保权限；板子无软件 reboot 命令（CONFIG_BOARDCTL_RESET 未开）。⚠️ 物理"复位键"不等于断电重启：2026-10-11 按复位后屏幕黑、应用没起、RNDIS QUERY 仍 stall（疑似走了 PMU 低功耗启动分支，见 sifli_ap.c 的 boot_reason/ULP 路径）；**重启板子一律用拔电-等3秒-插回的冷启动**，冷启动后 rndis_host 首次探测即自动绑定。板子 USB 重连（不冷启动）时 QUERY 可能因响应队列残留被 stall——nuttx/drivers/usbdev/rndis.c INIT 分支清队列补丁 **2026-10-11 已烧录生效**。⚠️ sftool 的 `--after soft_reset` 与复位键同属 warm reset，会把 USB 数据通道卡死（主机症状：NETDEV WATCHDOG transmit queue timed out、ARP FAILED、控制通道却正常）——烧录后一律拔电-等3秒-插回再跑脚本。相关：[[sf32lb52-audio-drain-fix]]

content.thinking:
User reconnected the board (重新连接板子 — likely unplug/replug or VMware re-passthrough), ran the script, ping OK host→board, but "板子依旧没有网络" — board UI still shows no network.

This is the same signature as before: host→board ping works (that direction was never the issue), but board→internet (MQTT) fails and/or board→host :5600 fails, and the UI's 联网 flag is driven by MQTT session state.

Also important: the new firmware with INIT patch is flashed. If this was a USB re-plug WITHOUT power cycle (板子 stayed powered, USB re-enumerated), then per the earlier findings:
- INIT patch should prevent the -32 QUERY stall (bind succeeded — script found netif — so probe worked)
- BUT the re-enumeration-without-power-cycle path ALSO had the wedged data channel issue (watchdog) — need to check
- AND the board's RNDIS netif state on the board side might be stale

Key question: was this a power cycle or just USB reconnect? "重新连接板子" sounds like re-plugging USB (maybe via VMware menu or physical replug) — possibly WITHOUT the 3-second power-off (if they just re-passthrough in VMware, the board might have stayed powered... actually physically unplugging USB power from the board typically powers it down if USB is its power source! The board is powered via USB presumably. So unplug+replug = cold boot anyway).

Hmm, but if it was a cold boot and the script succeeded with ping OK, why would the board have no network?

Diagnosis steps (same as the earlier mystery):
1. Ping board now — still alive?
2. :5600 listener — board→host round trip (LCDMIRROR retries every 2.5s, immediate test)
3. Check watchdog timeouts since reconnect — data channel wedged again?
4. ARP stateThe UI "没有网络" is MQTT-driven. Possible causes:
- Return path broken again (NM? no — nmcli managed no should persist... unless the new enx interface after re-enumeration got a new... no, MAC-based name stays enx00e04c534231, and unmanaged setting is per-device (MAC) — should hold)
- Data channel wedged (watchdog) — ping wouldn't work then though! Ping works, so host→board→host ICMP round trip is fine → L2/L3 round trip OK!
- Since ICMP round trip works, the return path is FINE. So :5600 should work too (TCP to host). MQTT to internet needs NAT — MASQUERADE rules persist (iptables) unless VM rebooted (no). DNS223.5.5.5 via NAT should work.
- So if :5600 connects and MQTT works at TCP level, the issue is app-side: the board app's MQTT client stuck on a dead session from BEFORE the reconnect (half-open socket, retransmit loop) — the app might not be closing it. Earlier today we saw exactly this: retransmit loop on a dead connection. The 10s net_retry_tick calls ai_network_start_shared — but if MQTT session object exists in a "connecting/established-but-dead" state, it might not re-initiate.

Wait — but with a COLD boot (power cycle), the app restarts fresh — no stale socket. Unless this reconnect was NOT a power cycle (board stayed powered: e.g., they only re-clicked VMware 可移动设备 connect/disconnect, which does NOT cut board power — board keeps running, USB re-enumerates).

"重新连接板子" — I read this as VMware-level reconnect (可移动设备 → disconnect → connect) or replugging the USB cable into the VM host. If the board stayed powered (USB data reconnected while board runs), the board-side USB stack re-attaches... on NuttX gadget side, host disconnect/reconnect triggers VBUS event; RNDIS re-inits (our INIT patch clears queue — probe worked). The APP meanwhile still holds its old sockets (LCDMIRROR retry loop, MQTT half-dead). The app does NOT restart. UI stays 未联网 if MQTT is stuck.

So current state likely: L3 fine (ping), maybe :5600 fine, MQTT app-level stuck. OR MQTT TCP fails at DNS/connect for some reason.

Test plan (I can do now):
1. ping (confirm still up)
2. :5600 listener 12s (round trip proof)
3. Check watchdog since reconnect time
4. If :5600 works, the problem is app/MQTT-side → fix = power cycle the board (app restarts fresh, MQTT reconnects cleanly). That's also consistent with "依旧" (still).

Also — is the UI's network flag possibly checking something else? From memory: UI "联网" tied to MQTT session state. So yes.

Run tests 1-3 in parallel now.

sudo rmmod rndis_host && sudo modprobe rndis_host

808	/* ================= 报警出声（2026-09-21：让路协议已删） =================
809	 *
810	 * 2026-09-15 定案过一条根因：报警当初是**唯一一条没做让路**的出声路径。
811	 *   - hello_app 的 ai_companion 是常开麦：开机起就占着 /dev/audio/audio0 的录音
812	 *     通路；本板音频是**半双工**、驱动里只有一个方向标志。
813	 *   - 板级报警模块 alarm_audio_open() 走 open -> CONFIGURE -> CONFIGURE(音量)
814	 *     -> START（board/contest_board/src/sf32lb52_alarm.c）。录音会话还是 RUNNING
815	 *     时，NuttX 音频上层（nuttx/audio/audio.c）那两处判断会**静默跳过** ——
816	 *     只有 state==OPEN 才把 CONFIGURE 转给驱动、只有 PREPARED/XRUN 才调下层
817	 *     start —— 最后照样 `return OK`：报警模块以为成功了，一行日志都没有。
818	 *   - 于是报警的 PCM 全写在录音会话上，DAC/功放从未打开、DMA 永不完成 →
819	 *     驱动每 5 秒打一条 `AUDIO: 等播放完成超时（buflen=1600），本块丢弃`，
820	 *     报警音一块都出不去，**全程无声**（现场日志实证）。
821	 *   - 对照：robot_ui 自己的提醒/播报有完整让路，所以它们正常出声 ——
822	 *     只有报警这条漏了。于是当时的对策是"出声前先请 hello_app 交出麦克风"。
823	 *
824	 * ★ 那套让路握手 2026-09-21 **整套删掉了**（用户拍板：「关闭让路…不需要做
825	 *   麦克风转让，因为我们的麦是常开的」；真机故障形状和取舍见
826	 *   app/hello_app/ai_companion_req.h 头上）：一个"整机一份、没有持有者概念"的
827	 *   方向电平，靠调用方自己守配对纪律（yield 之后到 reclaim 之间不许有任何
828	 *   return），真机上漏一次就是对方永久聋 —— 而麦克风本来不需要转让：
829	 *   放音时驱动会停掉录音通路并唤醒对方阻塞的 read（见 sf32lb52_audio 的
830	 *   `AUDIO: stop 唤醒 read`），对方（hello_app）自己的监听守护会在录音链路
831	 *   死了之后把它重开。
832	 *   所以报警这条路现在和提醒那条一样：**直接出声**，一个跨 app 调用都不需要；
833	 *   "报警期间续租让路"那件事也一起消失了。
834	 *
835	 * ⚠️ 为什么"出声 + 上报"仍然要放进一条**工作线程**，而不是就地做在
836	 * robot_ui_show_alarm() 里：
837	 *   show_alarm() 跑在 **LVGL 线程**（报警按钮的回调 / main.c 里 ui_post_panel 的
838	 *   投递）。alarm_trigger() 要碰板级音频设备，这一串动作没有理由压在那条线程上
839	 *   —— 这个项目因为"在 LVGL 线程里碰设备"冻过界面。所以拆成两半：
840	 *     ① LVGL 线程（robot_ui_show_alarm）：切页面 -> 置"要出声"标记 + 起出声线程；
841	 *     ② 工作线程（alarm_sound_worker）：出声 + 上报，报警期间每 1 秒看一次
842	 *        有没有新的触发，直到报警页关掉才收摊。
843	 *   出声/上报因此只晚一次线程调度（毫秒级）：页面仍然是第一步切出来的
844	 *   （"先切页面"那条踩坑教训不动）。
845	 */
846	
847	/* 出声线程每拍等多久（毫秒）：认领"报警页还开着时又来的新触发"，顺带让出 CPU。
848	 * 报警最长 60 秒，这条线程大部分时间是睡着的。 */
849	#define ALARM_SOUND_POLL_MS        1000
850	
851	/* 出声线程的栈：它只做 printf + 两个非阻塞调用（alarm_trigger 会碰板级音频设备、
852	 * report_alarm_queued 只入队），但 printf 和板级调用都要吃一些栈，照 main.c 里
853	 * 等价的那条线程给 16 KB，创建写法也一致（pthread_attr + DETACHED）。 */
854	#define ALARM_WORKER_STACK_SIZE    16384
855	
856	/* 报警出声的共享状态。写者有两条线程：LVGL 线程（show_alarm / close_alarm）和
857	 * 报警出声线程，所以用一把锁护住，判据只看这三个布尔量。
858	 *   alarm_sound_active  —— 报警还没结束（出声线程据此决定继续还是收摊）
859	 *   alarm_sound_pending —— 有一次"出声 + 上报"还没做（show_alarm 每次调用置位）
860	 *   alarm_worker_up     —— 出声线程活着（活着就不再起第二条） */
861	static pthread_mutex_t alarm_audio_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
862	static bool alarm_sound_active  = false;
863	static bool alarm_sound_pending = false;
864	static bool alarm_worker_up     = false;
865	
866	/**
867	 * @brief  出声 + 上报（原样搬过来的两句，参数、顺序一个字都没改）
868	 *
869	 * 顺序是踩坑换来的：**先出声、再上报**（上报走网络 MQTT/TLS，慢或卡住时声音
870	 * 必须已经出去了）。页面那一步在调用方（robot_ui_show_alarm）里，仍然排在最前面。
871	 *
872	 * ⚠️ 只许工作线程调（出声要动设备，见本节头上那段）。
873	 */
874	static void alarm_sound_do(void)
875	{
876	    int ret;
877	
878	    ret = alarm_trigger(ALARM_LEVEL_EMERGENCY, "ui",
879	                        "报警已触发，请尽快确认");
880	    if (ret != OK) {
881	        printf("robot_ui: alarm_trigger failed: %d\n", ret);
882	    }

/* ================= 报警出声（2026-09-21：让路协议已删） =================
 *
 * 2026-09-15 定案过一条根因：报警当初是**唯一一条没做让路**的出声路径。
 *   - hello_app 的 ai_companion 是常开麦：开机起就占着 /dev/audio/audio0 的录音
 *     通路；本板音频是**半双工**、驱动里只有一个方向标志。
 *   - 板级报警模块 alarm_audio_open() 走 open -> CONFIGURE -> CONFIGURE(音量)
 *     -> START（board/contest_board/src/sf32lb52_alarm.c）。录音会话还是 RUNNING
 *     时，NuttX 音频上层（nuttx/audio/audio.c）那两处判断会**静默跳过** ——
 *     只有 state==OPEN 才把 CONFIGURE 转给驱动、只有 PREPARED/XRUN 才调下层
 *     start —— 最后照样 `return OK`：报警模块以为成功了，一行日志都没有。
 *   - 于是报警的 PCM 全写在录音会话上，DAC/功放从未打开、DMA 永不完成 →
 *     驱动每 5 秒打一条 `AUDIO: 等播放完成超时（buflen=1600），本块丢弃`，
 *     报警音一块都出不去，**全程无声**（现场日志实证）。
 *   - 对照：robot_ui 自己的提醒/播报有完整让路，所以它们正常出声 ——
 *     只有报警这条漏了。于是当时的对策是"出声前先请 hello_app 交出麦克风"。
 *
 * ★ 那套让路握手 2026-09-21 **整套删掉了**（用户拍板：「关闭让路…不需要做
 *   麦克风转让，因为我们的麦是常开的」；真机故障形状和取舍见
 *   app/hello_app/ai_companion_req.h 头上）：一个"整机一份、没有持有者概念"的
 *   方向电平，靠调用方自己守配对纪律（yield 之后到 reclaim 之间不许有任何
 *   return），真机上漏一次就是对方永久聋 —— 而麦克风本来不需要转让：
 *   放音时驱动会停掉录音通路并唤醒对方阻塞的 read（见 sf32lb52_audio 的
 *   `AUDIO: stop 唤醒 read`），对方（hello_app）自己的监听守护会在录音链路
 *   死了之后把它重开。
 *   所以报警这条路现在和提醒那条一样：**直接出声**，一个跨 app 调用都不需要；
 *   "报警期间续租让路"那件事也一起消失了。
 *
 * ⚠️ 为什么"出声 + 上报"仍然要放进一条**工作线程**，而不是就地做在
 * robot_ui_show_alarm() 里：
 *   show_alarm() 跑在 **LVGL 线程**（报警按钮的回调 / main.c 里 ui_post_panel 的
 *   投递）。alarm_trigger() 要碰板级音频设备，这一串动作没有理由压在那条线程上
 *   —— 这个项目因为"在 LVGL 线程里碰设备"冻过界面。所以拆成两半：
 *     ① LVGL 线程（robot_ui_show_alarm）：切页面 -> 置"要出声"标记 + 起出声线程；
 *     ② 工作线程（alarm_sound_worker）：出声 + 上报，报警期间每 1 秒看一次
 *        有没有新的触发，直到报警页关掉才收摊。
 *   出声/上报因此只晚一次线程调度（毫秒级）：页面仍然是第一步切出来的
 *   （"先切页面"那条踩坑教训不动）。
 */

/* 出声线程每拍等多久（毫秒）：认领"报警页还开着时又来的新触发"，顺带让出 CPU。
 * 报警最长 60 秒，这条线程大部分时间是睡着的。 */
#define ALARM_SOUND_POLL_MS        1000

/* 出声线程的栈：它只做 printf + 两个非阻塞调用（alarm_trigger 会碰板级音频设备、
 * report_alarm_queued 只入队），但 printf 和板级调用都要吃一些栈，照 main.c 里
 * 等价的那条线程给 16 KB，创建写法也一致（pthread_attr + DETACHED）。 */
#define ALARM_WORKER_STACK_SIZE    16384

/* 报警出声的共享状态。写者有两条线程：LVGL 线程（show_alarm / close_alarm）和
 * 报警出声线程，所以用一把锁护住，判据只看这三个布尔量。
 *   alarm_sound_active  —— 报警还没结束（出声线程据此决定继续还是收摊）
 *   alarm_sound_pending —— 有一次"出声 + 上报"还没做（show_alarm 每次调用置位）
 *   alarm_worker_up     —— 出声线程活着（活着就不再起第二条） */
static pthread_mutex_t alarm_audio_lock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static bool alarm_sound_active  = false;
static bool alarm_sound_pending = false;
static bool alarm_worker_up     = false;

/**
 * @brief  出声 + 上报（原样搬过来的两句，参数、顺序一个字都没改）
 *
 * 顺序是踩坑换来的：**先出声、再上报**（上报走网络 MQTT/TLS，慢或卡住时声音
 * 必须已经出去了）。页面那一步在调用方（robot_ui_show_alarm）里，仍然排在最前面。
 *
 * ⚠️ 只许工作线程调（出声要动设备，见本节头上那段）。
 */
static void alarm_sound_do(void)
{
    int ret;

    ret = alarm_trigger(ALARM_LEVEL_EMERGENCY, "ui",
                        "报警已触发，请尽快确认");
    if (ret != OK) {
        printf("robot_ui: alarm_trigger failed: %d\n", ret);
    }

这一节把机理讲透了，而且是**已实证的根因**：本板音频**半双工**，常开麦的录音会话一直 RUNNING 时，NuttX 音频上层会**静默跳过** CONFIGURE/START（`return OK` 不报错），于是播放的 PCM 全写在录音会话上，DAC/功放从未打开 → 每 5 秒丢一块 → 全程无声。

但注释里 2026-09-21 的乐观假设——「放音时驱动会停掉录音通路」——现在被你的日志**证伪了**：`等播放完成超时` 还在刷，说明放音没能抢下通路。关键要看驱动现在的 stop/唤醒逻辑是否真的生效。查两处：

确认了：**完全无声，是真 bug，不是 LLM 配置问题**。串口日志已经把根因钉死了——这是那条**已实证的历史 bug 复发**：

> 本板音频**半双工**，常开麦（hello_app 录音线程）一直占着 `/dev/audio/audio0` 的录音会话时，NuttX 音频上层会**静默跳过** CONFIGURE/START（`return OK` 不报错）。于是滑屏 click 的 PCM 全写在了录音会话上，DAC/功放从头到尾没被打开 → DMA 永不完成 → 每块都被丢 → 全程无声。日志里那句 `AUDIO: 等播放完成超时，本块丢弃` 就是铁证。

当初是靠「让路协议」绕开的，但让路已在 9-21 被整套删除（你拍板的，理由是「麦常开，不需要转让」）——删除时假设「放音时驱动会自动停掉录音」，**这个假设被你现在的现场证伪了**。

When the recorder holds state RUNNING, a playback app's CONFIGURE is silently swallowed (returns OK, sets priv->state = PREPARED per-fd but global state stays RUNNING). Then `audio_start`: global state RUNNING is not OPEN/PAUSED/PREPARED/XRUN → skips lower start entirely → `priv->state = RUNNING; return OK`. So the playback app believes it started. write() flows to the lower half... wait, does write even reach the lower half without start? Yes — audio_write → lower->ops->write. The lower half write path in the board driver queues DMA etc. — but hw never armed (no hw_start) → no DAC path → DMA never completes → "等播放完成超时，本块丢弃" every block. Exactly matches.

So why did audio_test tone work earlier? Sequence: audio_test opens fresh device at a moment when... hmm, actually the global state machine: when hello_app's recorder was RUNNING, audio_test's CONFIGURE would ALSO be swallowed. Unless at tone-test time the recorder was NOT running (e.g., those chaos boots where hello_app was still initializing, or the recorder had died and the guard hadn't reopened yet — actually the recorder monitor reopens within 100ms...).

They reflashed, power-cycled, and immediately ran audio_test from NSH probably within the first seconds of boot while hello_app recorder hadn't yet started (app init takes a while — network, LVGL, then audio). 2. Any other app's playback CONFIGURE/START silently swallowed → no hw_start → blocks dropped → silence.
3. Driver-level preemption never gets the chance; even if it did, the lower half refuses preemption (-EBUSY) while the recorder is alive.

上层状态机读完，**整个因果链彻底闭合了**。真相是：

**NuttX 音频上层是全局单状态机**——`CONFIGURE` 只有在 `OPEN` 时才转给驱动（[audio.c:479](openvela/nuttx/audio/audio.c#L479)），`START` 只有在 `PREPARED/XRUN` 时才调下层（[audio.c:633](openvela/nuttx/audio/audio.c#L633)）。hello_app 的常开麦把状态顶在 `RUNNING` 之后，**任何其他 app（报警、提醒）的播放 CONFIGURE/START 都被静默吞掉**（返回 OK 但驱动根本没被通知）→ DAC/功放从未打开 → 每块 PCM 等 DMA 超时被丢 → 全程无声。日志里 `hw_start 真跑了` 一次没出现，就是铁证。

这解释了所有现象：

- **当时 audio_test 测试音为什么能响**：刚烧完固件立刻测，抢在录音线程接管之前赢了状态机——是「开机竞速」赢的，不是通路真的健康
- **现在为什么完全无声**：板子已开机 20 多分钟，麦早被占死，所有播放都是死路
- **click 为什么没声**：`touch_ui_play_sound` 是 `TODO` 空壳，只 printf，从来没实现
- **让路协议删除（9-21 你拍板）后**，注释里假设「放音时驱动会停掉录音」——但上层这道门让 START 根本到不了驱动，假设落空

```
audio_test 1000 1000
```

Same pattern: INIT succeeded (no "RNDIS init failed"), QUERY (0x01010101) -32, on a fresh power cycle with the NEW firmware (post-flash boot at 22:37:49). This is now 4 consecutive cold boots with QUERY failing — definitively systematic on the new firmware.

Now the critical question: what did the BOARD serial log show during this enumeration? The user had picocom open during the power cycle (step 3 of my instructions). The board-side log at the moment of enumeration would show if the uerr fired ("RNDIS control message without data stage" or "response queue full"). 

Key insight I should reconsider: what does the QUERY exchange look like at the USB level?

1. Host → board: SEND_ENCAPSULATED_COMMAND (CLASS, INTERFACE) with data stage = rndis_query_msg (24 bytes: hdr(16: msgtype, msglen, reqid, status) + objid + ... wait rndis_query_msg = hdr(16) + objid(4) + ... = actually query msg = response header fields: MessageType, MessageLength, RequestId, Status, then OID, InformationBufferLength, InformationBufferOffset... The QUERY control message: wLength = sizeof(query_msg)=24+?

2. Board responds with RESPONSE_AVAILABLE interrupt notification.

3. Host → board: GET_ENCAPSULATED_RESPONSE (IN) → gets the query complete with MAC.

The -32 comes at step 1 (usb_control_msg for the QUERY send fails with -EPIPE) OR step 3. The host log "RNDIS_MSG_QUERY(0x01010101) failed, -32" is logged by rndis_query_oid → rndis_msg_ctrl → usb_control_msg(SendEncapsulatedCommand...) — if THAT failed, "rndis get ethaddr, -32" follows. So the SEND of the QUERY control message got stalled, OR the response wait failed. rndis_msg_ctrl: sends msg via usb_control_msg SEND_ENCAPSULATED_COMMAND, then waits for RESPONSE_AVAILABLE and GETs. The -32 could be from either control_msg.

Board-side uerr possibilities for the QUERY send:
- "RNDIS control message without data stage (%u bytes)" — outlen < 8. The QUERY has a data stage of ~24 bytes... unless the OUT data stage wasn't captured.
- "RNDIS response queue full" — queue has room (INIT cleared it, INIT response consumed).

What if the QUERY SETUP arrives while the board's ep0 is mid-status-stage of the previous transfer (the GET_ENCAPSULATED_RESPONSE of the INIT response)? The vendor UDC handles SETUPEND... The pattern "INIT succeeds, QUERY stalls immediately" = the SECOND control message after a response-IN gets stalled.

Interesting — this matches the earlier summary's ep0 notes: "OUT data-stage parking (g_ep0pending/g_ep0outbuf/g_ep0outdataend), SETUPEND handling, DATAEND-on-short-packet fix — all pre-existing fixes". There might be a residual race on the OUT data stage of the second control transfer.

I NEED the board-side serial log from the enumeration moment to see if a uerr printed. The user did step 3 (picocom during power cycle) — ask them to paste the serial output from the power cycle (the part around USB enumeration / RNDIS init).
